newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema stock zig-zags amid mixed sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Bema stock zig-zags amid mixed sentiment.

text.p: Bema Gold Corp shares see-sawed Friday, rising early but then slipping back to a small loss as the stock was buffeted by mixed investor sentiment.

The stock was trading down 0.05 at 10.55. It peaked at 11.25 earlier in what analysts said was a recovery from an overdone fall Thursday on drill results from the company's Cerro Casale gold project in Chile. The company and its partner Arizona Star Resource Corp said one hole showed a big increase in the width of the main porphyry zone but investors were disappointed by the grades.

Some analysts viewed the disappointment as unjustified. Wolverton Securities analyst Art Ettlinger said the results were reasonable and showed Bema was seeking to define the deposit and expand it at depth.
"Yesterday (the drop) was an overreaction to subeconomic results...The market is assay driven," he said. "Today people are starting to realize that this is part of the process."
Another analyst said the erratic market action signalled confusion. Bema stock has soared on investor optimism and is becoming prone to volatility as developments unfold at the property.
